name: Flesh Current
description: Run qi through muscle as through a channel so every limb gains easy lasting power.

name: Sinew Pulse
description: Send a pulse of qi along the sinew of the arm so the strike lands with muscle and qi together.

name: Frame Veil
description: Fill the frame of the body with qi so the veil and the bone take a blow as one.

name: Sinew Crack
description: Whip the arm out with qi snapping in the sinew so the blow numbs the foe's guard.

name: Flesh Mend
description: Drive qi into torn muscle of yourself or an ally so the flesh draws together quickly.

name: Frame Heave
description: Heave with the whole frame and let the qi burst outward from the chest.

name: Forged Circuit
description: Run the circuit through tempered flesh so the guard stands firm and small wounds close as they open.

name: Embodied Rush
description: Rush the foe with the body and qi moving as one and strike at the end of the run.

name: Embodied Tide
description: Let the body itself become the tide and roll across the ground in a crushing wave of qi.

name: Armored Unity
description: streams: Qi + Body; merge qi and tempered flesh into one armor that shrugs off great blows and is lighter than either alone.

name: Will Current
description: Set the will on the flow of qi so it runs straighter and each limb answers faster.

name: Imprint Pulse
description: Press intent into a pulse of qi so the blow strikes the mind a little as well as the body.

name: Intent Veil
description: Hold a veil shaped by the will so it stiffens exactly where a blow is meant to land.

name: Imprint Thread
description: Drive a thread of qi carrying intent through a guard and into the foe's focus.

name: Intent Reading
description: Read what a foe means to do from the set of their qi before they move.

name: Spirit Balm
description: Pour qi and kind intent into an ally or yourself to ease both the wound and the fear.

name: Intent Lash
description: Lash a foe with intent-bearing qi that jars their concentration as it strikes.

name: Imprinted Surge
description: Send a wide surge of qi stamped with the will so it shocks bodies and minds alike.

name: Imprinted Purge
description: Wash an ally's channels and spirit with imprinted qi to lift taint and shaken nerves.

name: Intent Anchor
description: Anchor the will in the qi so the guard cannot be shaken and the user's strength stays whole.

name: Unthought Strike
description: streams: Qi + Soul; let soul and qi move as one so the blow forms and lands before the thought of it is finished.

name: Wrought Palm
description: Strike with a palm wrought from tempered flesh and dense qi in a single stroke.

name: Wrought Veil
description: Cover the body in a veil of dense qi that rests on tempered bone.

name: Wrought Pace
description: Take a heavy pace in which flesh and qi spring together and the ground shakes.

name: Wrought Lance
description: Drive a stiffened arm and a lance of qi through a guard as a single piercing line.

name: Wrought Hold
description: Clamp a foe in a grip of flesh and qi that crushes the will to struggle.

name: Wrought Mend
description: Rebuild torn flesh of an ally or yourself with qi that runs deep into the tempered frame.

name: Wrought Surge
description: Throw the whole body into a stamp and let the qi roll out across the ground.

name: Wrought Mantle
description: Wear a mantle of dense qi on the frame that turns blows and slowly renews the flesh beneath.

name: Wrought Onslaught
description: Hurl the wrought body at the foe in a charge whose force breaks over the whole ground around.

name: Wrought Union
description: streams: Qi + Body; knit the Core's qi into the whole frame so it stands as one indestructible body.

name: Unison Pulse
description: Strike with a pulse in which the will and the qi beat once together.

name: Unison Veil
description: Hold a veil that thickens wherever the will looks without any effort of direction.

name: Unison Stride
description: Step the instant the will decides and let the qi carry the foot there unbidden.

name: Unison Lance
description: Cast a lance of qi that flies where the eye is fixed without any aim.

name: Unison Reading
description: Read a foe's mind and body in one pass of qi and know their next three moves.

name: Unison Salve
description: Heal both flesh and spirit of an ally with qi that follows the will alone.

name: Unison Bind
description: Bind a foe's limbs and intent together so neither obeys them until the bind is freed.

name: Unison Surge
description: Surge out as will and qi at once in a wave that no one near can brace against.

name: Unison Cleansing
description: Cleanse an ally of curse taint backlash and soul-bruise with a single unbroken flow.

name: Unison Ascendant
description: Raise will and qi together to a high pitch so every strike of the user lands harder and truer.

name: Fulfilled Unison
description: streams: Qi + Soul; strike with soul and the Core's qi fully joined so intent and force arrive in one instant.
